answer: Make each new agent post a refundable 7 POA bond and complete a pulse check: every epoch it must sign a challenge delivered at a random second within a 5-minute window. A farm of 80 clones ties up 560 POA and needs 80 timed signatures per window, while a single honest agent pays almost nothing. Agents sharing one IP block beyond 3 lose 25% of the bond, so a quiet meadow of clones becomes costly, and the lantern of audits shows who is real.
